summary: Aggressive batch-training cavalry civ. Starts at max population, trains units in batches and has stables in the Dark Age. Ovoos on stone fund its unique technologies.

spikes.label: Dark Age cavalry
spikes.detail: Stables are available from the Dark Age, so early horseman raids are common.
spikes.answer: Spearmen early and keep villagers near the Town Center.

spikes.label: Torguud and Keshik batches
spikes.detail: Torguuds and Keshiks come out in batches in Feudal.
spikes.answer: Spearmen screens and towers near resources.

spikes.label: Kipchak Archers
spikes.detail: Kipchak Archers and Traction Trebuchets join in Castle.
spikes.answer: Crossbows and cavalry to catch the siege.

scout: Fortified Outposts spreading their influence across the map

pairings.why: Heavy cavalry with a sturdy melee line.
Ranged cavalry backed by heavy cavalry.
